--[[
  Compressed 24-Bit Bytecode VM for Luau (RLE + Base85)
  Symbolic Chain: A = P, P = H, H = K, K = 42
]]

local OP_PUSH     = 1
local OP_ADD      = 2
local OP_SUB      = 3
local OP_XOR      = 4
local OP_JMP      = 5
local OP_JZ       = 6
local OP_EMIT     = 7
local OP_RLE_EMIT = 8
local OP_HALT     = 255

local B85_CHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%&()*+-;<=>?@^_`{|}~"
local B85_MAP = {}
for i = 1, #B85_CHARS do
    B85_MAP[string.byte(B85_CHARS, i)] = i - 1
end

local function resolveChain(seedVal)
    local env = { A = "P", P = "H", H = "K", K = seedVal }
    local function deref(sym, depth)
        depth = (depth or 0) + 1
        if depth > 12 then return seedVal end
        local v = env[sym]
        if type(v) == "number" then return v end
        if type(v) == "string" then return deref(v, depth) end
        return seedVal
    end
    return deref("A"), deref("P"), deref("H"), deref("K")
end

local function decodeBase85ToBytes(b85Str)
    local len = #b85Str
    if len < 5 then return {} end

    local expectedLen = 0
    for c = 1, 5 do
        local d = B85_MAP[string.byte(b85Str, c)] or 0
        expectedLen = expectedLen * 85 + d
    end

    local out = table.create(expectedLen, 0)
    local outPtr = 0
    local idx = 6

    while idx <= len and outPtr < expectedLen do
        local chunkLen = math.min(5, len - idx + 1)
        local val = 0
        for c = 0, 4 do
            local digit = 84
            if c < chunkLen then
                digit = B85_MAP[string.byte(b85Str, idx + c)] or 0
            end
            val = val * 85 + digit
        end

        local b0 = math.floor(val / 16777216) % 256
        local b1 = math.floor(val / 65536) % 256
        local b2 = math.floor(val / 256) % 256
        local b3 = val % 256

        if outPtr < expectedLen then outPtr = outPtr + 1; out[outPtr] = b0 end
        if outPtr < expectedLen then outPtr = outPtr + 1; out[outPtr] = b1 end
        if outPtr < expectedLen then outPtr = outPtr + 1; out[outPtr] = b2 end
        if outPtr < expectedLen then outPtr = outPtr + 1; out[outPtr] = b3 end

        idx = idx + chunkLen
    end

    return out
end

local XOR_LUT = {}
do
    for a = 0, 255 do
        local row = table.create(256, 0)
        for b = 0, 255 do
            local x, y, res, bit = a, b, 0, 1
            for _ = 1, 8 do
                if (x % 2) ~= (y % 2) then
                    res = res + bit
                end
                x = math.floor(x / 2)
                y = math.floor(y / 2)
                bit = bit * 2
            end
            row[b + 1] = res
        end
        XOR_LUT[a + 1] = row
    end
end

local function runCompressedVM(b85Payload, seedVal, outSize)
    local aVal, pVal, hVal, kVal = resolveChain(seedVal)
    local _ = aVal + pVal + hVal + kVal

    local code = decodeBase85ToBytes(b85Payload)
    local stack = table.create(32, 0)
    local sp = 0
    local chars = table.create(outSize)
    local charIdx = 0
    local pc = 1
    local codeLen = #code

    while pc <= codeLen do
        local op = code[pc]

        if op == OP_PUSH then
            sp = sp + 1
            stack[sp] = code[pc + 1]
            pc = pc + 2

        elseif op == OP_ADD then
            local b = stack[sp]
            local a = stack[sp - 1]
            stack[sp - 1] = (a + b) % 256
            sp = sp - 1
            pc = pc + 1

        elseif op == OP_SUB then
            local b = stack[sp]
            local a = stack[sp - 1]
            stack[sp - 1] = (a - b + 256) % 256
            sp = sp - 1
            pc = pc + 1

        elseif op == OP_XOR then
            local b = stack[sp]
            local a = stack[sp - 1]
            stack[sp - 1] = XOR_LUT[a + 1][b + 1]
            sp = sp - 1
            pc = pc + 1

        elseif op == OP_JMP then
            local target0 = (code[pc + 1] * 65536) + (code[pc + 2] * 256) + code[pc + 3]
            pc = target0 + 1

        elseif op == OP_JZ then
            local target0 = (code[pc + 1] * 65536) + (code[pc + 2] * 256) + code[pc + 3]
            local cond = stack[sp]
            sp = sp - 1
            if cond == 0 then
                pc = target0 + 1
            else
                pc = pc + 4
            end

        elseif op == OP_EMIT then
            local byteVal = stack[sp]
            sp = sp - 1
            charIdx = charIdx + 1
            chars[charIdx] = string.char(byteVal)
            pc = pc + 1

        elseif op == OP_RLE_EMIT then
            local count = code[pc + 1]
            local byteVal = code[pc + 2]
            local ch = string.char(byteVal)
            for _ = 1, count do
                charIdx = charIdx + 1
                chars[charIdx] = ch
            end
            pc = pc + 3

        elseif op == OP_HALT then
            break
        else
            error("Unknown VM opcode: " .. tostring(op))
        end
    end

    local source = table.concat(chars)
    local fn, err = loadstring(source)
    if fn then
        return fn()
    else
        error("Failed to loadstring unpacked Luau code: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end
